progressAppend: R58 compared Three.js r186's omitted/default HalfFloatType output buffer against explicit FloatType using the exact locked R55 source. In the working software WebGL route, Float matched all 1024 channels exactly; HalfFloat changed every channel with maxAbs 0.000244140625 and RMSE 0.000102134 while using 2048 rather than 4096 raw target bytes. Final opaque-black sRGB canvases differed in 18/768 RGB channels by at most one code, rejecting the claim that final 8-bit output necessarily hides internal precision differences. Both WebGPU readbacks reproduced the R57 external-instance mapAsync boundary, so no WebGPU numeric comparison was obtained. No independent physical root, hardware/device/asset evidence or human acceptance was added.
